Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83752654888
Zoom Meeting ID: 837 5265 4888
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 837 5265 4888#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all councilmembers. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City Council during the meeting, please utilize the "Raise Hand" feature during the meeting, or email CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards.

  MINUTES
  OF THE FEBRUARY 9, 2021 REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

A Teleconference meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City Council meeting via Zoom pursuant
to Executive Order N25-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March 26, 2020, was called
to order by Mayor Kemps at 6:30 P.M. on January 26, 2021, notice having been given with
affidavit thereto on file. Members of the public were provided with the following information
to provide public input:

  BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83752654888
  Zoom Meeting ID: 837 5265 4888
  BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 837 5265 4888#
  BY EMAIL: CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org

Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are
available on the City's website under City Council Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.

NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R21-06

NEXT ORDINANCE NO. 021-748

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

PRESENT: Mayor Kemps, Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi, Councilmembers McGowan, Roos and
Murdock

ALSO PRESENT:
City Manager Guglielmo, City Attorney Cotti, Treasurer Greenberg, Acting Police Chief Best,
Acting Planning & Building Director Rindge, City Support Services Director Hannah, City Clerk
Chaney

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember McGowan, seconded by Councilmember
  Murdock to approve the agenda.
  AYES: Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES: None

MAYOR'S REPORT - MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST

Mayor Kemps noted that the Malaga Cove Homeowners Association invited him to present a
State of the City address, and noted that the Council may want to agendize the topic of
consideration and collaboration. He thanked everyone for participating in the Police Ad Hoc
Committee meeting, and thanked the Police Department for their service.

 CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
 FEBRUARY 9, 2021
 City Manager Guglielmo noted current Request for Proposals that are out and due soon for
Information Technology Services and Audit services. She also noted that the City will be looking
for resident volunteers for various needs.

Acting Police Chief Best provided an update on traffic control in Malaga Cove, and asked the
  1
Community to remember the Tracy and Vanderpool families on February 14 h.

Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

Desiree Myers and Valerie Gorsuch addressed the City Council.

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 -6)

  ACTION: Moved by Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi, seconded by Councilmember McGowan to
  approve the consent agenda.
  AYES: Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES: None

  Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

1.  City Council Action Minutes

  Reviewed and Approved:
  a.  January 26, 2021 Special Closed Session Meeting Minutes
  b.  January 26, 2021 Regular Meeting Minutes
  c.  January 30, 2021 Special Meeting Minutes

2.  Approval of Warrant Registers

  Reviewed and Approved Warrant Registers: 02092021-A, 02052021-A.

3.  Item Removed.

4.  Consideration of a Resolution to Oppose State Legislation that Undermines
  Local Control Over Housing and Land Use Decisions and the Public's Right to
  Provide Input Into Such Decisions, and Authorize the Mayor to Sign Letters of
  Opposition to Such Bills

  Recommendation: 1) Adopt Resolution 21-06 - A resolution of the City Council of
  the City of Palos Verdes Estates to oppose State legislation that undermines local
  control over housing and land use decisions and the public's right to provide input
  into such decisions; and 2) Authorize the Mayor to sign letters of opposition to such
  bills.

 5.  Adoption of Proposed Resolution R21-07 Authorizing the City Manager to
  Execute, on Behalf of the City, Applications for Federal Financial Assistance
  and/or State Financial Assistance in the Event of a Disaster

  Recommendation: (1) Adopt proposed resolution R21-07 authorizing the City
  Manager to execute, on behalf of the City, applications for federal financial assistance
  and/or state financial assistance in the event of a disaster.

 6.  Approval of an Amendment to the Existing Contract with RCS Investigations
  to Increase the Contract Not-To-Exceed Amount to $32,760

  Recommendation: Approve an amendment to the existing contract with RCS
  Investigations to increase the contract not-to-exceed amount to $32,760.

 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
 FEBRUARY 9, 2021
 ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT AGENDA

3.  Recommendations of the Park.lands Committee for January 14, 2021

  Recommendation: Approve the actions of the Park.lands Committee for the meeting
  of January 14, 2021.

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Murdock, seconded by Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi
  to approve items #1 and #2 of the Park.lands Committee Action, to set #3, PC-548-21
  Application to remove two Italian stone pines and one Eucalyptus located in the
  parkway adjacent to 2304 Paseo Del Mar and waive the planting of the Designated
  Street Tree for a Public Hearing on March 9, 2021.
  AYES: Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES: None

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Murdock, seconded by Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi
  to place on a future agenda a review of the City's Tree management policy and
  process, and provide further guidance to the Parklands Committee.
  AYES: Murdock, Roos, Lozzi, Kemps
  ABSTAIN: McGowan
  NOES: None

CEREMONIAL MATTERS

PUBLIC HEARING(S)

OLD BUSINESS

NEW BUSINESS

  of Understanding Between the City Of Palos Verdes Estates and the Palos Verdes
  Estates Public Service Employees Association

  Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Murdock, seconded by Councilmember
  McGowan to Adopt Resolution R2 l-08 approving the amendment to the
  Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the City of Palos Verdes Estates
  (City) and the Palos Verdes Estates Public Service Employees Association (PSE)
  extending the term through June 30, 2021 in accordance with the Letter of
  Amendment.

  AYES: Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES: None

 MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS

 Councilmember Murdock reported that she attended the South Bay Cities Council of
 Government Steering Committee Meeting.

 Councilmember Roos reported that he also attended the South Bay Cities Council of Government
 Steering Committee Meeting, and noted the discussion of a regional planner position and updates
 on County Public Health.

 Councilmember McGowan noted he attended the Sanitation Board meeting and will be
 participating in the Disaster Preparedness meeting.

 Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi provided updates on PV Transit and possible expansion for vaccine
 appointment service.

 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
 FEBRUARY 9, 2021
 Mayor Kemps requested an agenda item for consideration on the potential financial impacts of
decisions made by the Council of Governments Board.

CLOSED SESSION

The City Council went into Closed Session from 7:20 p.m. to 9:58 p.m.

CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT

City Attorney John Cotti noted that the Council provided instruction to labor negotiators and
took no further reportable action.
